label: Water flow

help.en: Is the water moving, or is it still and stagnant?
help.hi: Paani beh raha hai ya ruka hua hai?

cross_exam: Watch a leaf or bubble on the surface: does it drift downstream within a few seconds?
Is any part of the channel you can see completely dry?

label: Water colour

help.en: What colour is the water compared with clean stream water?
help.hi: Saaf paani ke muqable is paani ka rang kaisa hai?

cross_exam: In knee-deep water, can you see stones on the bottom?
Is the colour the same upstream and downstream, or does it change at one spot?

label: Channel shape and banks

help.en: Does the stream still wind naturally, or has it been straightened and lined?
help.hi: Nadi apne natural mod ke saath behti hai, ya seedhi karke pakki kar di gayi hai?

cross_exam: Are the banks soil and stone, or concrete, brick and cement?
Does the channel bend along its length, or run in a straight line?

label: Bankside vegetation

help.en: How much natural plant cover grows along the banks?
help.hi: Kinaron pe kitne natural paudhe aur ped hain?

cross_exam: Do trees or shrubs shade any part of the water?
Is there plant cover on both banks, or only on one side?

label: Pipes and discharge points

help.en: Can you see pipes, drains or outlets emptying into the stream?
help.hi: Koi pipe, naali ya drain nadi mein gir rahi hai?

cross_exam: Is anything actually flowing out of the pipe right now, or is it dry?
Does the water change colour, foam or smell just below the outlet?

label: Litter and debris

help.en: How much plastic, waste or dumped material can you see in or beside the water?
help.hi: Paani mein ya kinare pe kitna plastic, kachra ya malba dikh raha hai?

cross_exam: Is it mostly plastic and packaging, or natural leaves and branches?
Is the waste floating in the water, or only lying on the bank?

label: Invasive plants

help.en: Do aggressive spreading plants such as water hyacinth or lantana cover the water or banks?
help.hi: Jalkumbhi ya lantana jaise tezi se failne wale paudhe paani ya kinare pe chhaye hain?

cross_exam: Do you see floating mats of water hyacinth sitting on the surface?
Is one single plant type crowding out everything else?

label: Hard surfaces around the stream

help.en: How much of the ground around the stream is paved, built over or sealed?
help.hi: Nadi ke aas-paas kitni zameen pakki, sadak ya building se dhaki hai?

cross_exam: If it rained now, would water soak into the ground, or run straight into the stream?
Is there a road, parking area or building right at the bank?
